title: Approve reviews with judgment-override note
description: Exercises the per-step `note` field — a human-authored hint that the renderer emits as a `> Note from recorder:` blockquote before the bash block. Used to defeat agent over-judgment on steps whose meaning isn't obvious from the recording alone.

steps.intent: Approve review 349 (looks neutral, but ground truth marks it positive)
steps.note: Approve this row even though the comment reads "OKish". The WebArena evaluator treats it as positive — do not skip based on your own sentiment judgment.

steps.intent: Multi-line note: set status to Approved
steps.note:
Status value 1 = Approved.
This is the magic constant Magento uses internally — don't try to write "Approved" as a string.
